title: Fläche_up-1c
slide_intent: Use a consistent vertical path so the viewer follows a transition without competing directions.
strategic_value: An upward red plane can express DB movement with a compact, repeatable visual action.
demonstration: A red plane rises from the bottom, covers the frame, and leaves through the top.
practical_value: Choose the one-color vertical treatment when the composition benefits from an upward transition.

content_islands.spec: Rise from the bottom edge with a red plane.

content_islands.name: Exit
content_islands.spec: Continue upward until the plane clears the top edge.
